q1_issues.issue: The restrictive modifier "Additional" is dropped from both download bundles (statements 2 and 3), widening the claim from additional applications/software to applications/software at large.

The subject is a bare plural / mass kind, but the modal is encoded as (Can <event-witness>) on a minted event, which the instruction set reserves for a specific subject's ability; a capability over a kind is routed to a reified property instead.

q2_gaps: a passive capability/possibility generic over a kind ("Ns can be V-ed") — the kind-level form (Inheritance <kind> (can <verb>)) encodes an action the kind performs, so there is no licensed kind-level carrier when the kind is the modal's undergoer and the agent is unexpressed
a descriptive restrictive adjective ("additional") on a bare-kind object filler — the bare class symbol has no bearer for a Member property atom
notes: The narrow Or scoping, Instrument for "via", Source for "from a PC", the definite phone typed outside the bundle while the indefinite PC/USB witnesses stay inside their Or branch, and the usb_connection genus are all handled per the instruction set. The indefinite sk_pc_1 / sk_usb_1 witnesses and their typing atoms are reused across both strength-1.0 bundles, restating the same existentials twice.
